repair_dataflow: Stack words12..44 are immutable vertex0{x,y,invW}, vertex1{x,y,invW}, vertex2{x,y,invW}; center uses vertex1; four FMSUB differences, two products and ordered product0-product1 subtraction match positive-W CPU culling.
rounding_and_flags: All nine arithmetic instructions explicitly RNE. Both front/back comparisons are pinned FLE, preserving ordered NaN semantics despite -ffast-math. Caller FCSR is saved before arithmetic and restored before serial/ACK writes.
admission: Actual extracted collection loop passes independent 20,003-stream test, atomic TRI2, count64, global-to-local indices and ownership/hash gates. Hardware metadata has its own real LOAD SCAN test.
lifetime: Actual lazy copy/materialize/all/triangle/fog/pre-G_VTX block passes existing eager-reference 8,000-load test after inserting a no-side-effect release stub. GPU ownership and release order separately tested on actual hardware. Queued path reloads all later CPU cache slots conservatively; CLAIM is reused only for the current generation and explicit RELEASE is emitted before G_VTX/frame end.
limits: This app review does not establish native full-frame correctness or speed; root owns matched replay comparison.
Native arithmetic extraction tests operand values and flag behavior; actual service MMIO transport is covered by worker tests and final ELF read/write ordering inspection.
